Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout

Class LayoutResult

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.layout.LayoutResult
public final class LayoutResult extends Object
The geometry computed by Smetana, copied into plain Java objects so that the drawing does not depend on Smetana any more.

Coordinates are final drawing coordinates: origin at the top-left corner of the graph bounding box, Y going down, rankdir already applied.
